description:
Art-W Studio created a New Army Blueprint for YOU, a Free Guide so you can start planning your next army now, with clarity, structure and long-term vision: https://artwstudio.ac-page.com/aws-lp-the-new-army-blueprint-en . Art-W Studio is the sponsor for this 40k in 40m.

When the Dark Angels and Space Wolves meet on the battlefield, usually as "allies", these meetings include a ritualistic Honour Duel between two champions representing their respective chapters. Army Lists Below.

For the first time on Play On Tabletop, we see Dark Angels face the Space Wolves, and we chose a mission which begins with an Honour Duel but escalate into two Chapter Masters squaring off against each other. Watch Mubin pilots the Dark Angels for the very first time and Tak brings out his beloved Space Wolves.
